body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Haier introduced its first line of digital cameras to its electronics division during CES 2010.

With options and features that reduce red-eye and aid in image stabilization, Haier's digital cameras make it easy for consumers to take great photos. One simple connection allows for quick uploads of video and photos to computers, printers or online. All Haier cameras support YouTube video upload to share videos with friends and family.

In particular, the 'DC-S50/S51/S52/S60' is equipped with a 12.0-megapixel 1/2.3-inch CCD with a 3× optical zoom and a 5× digital zoom lens. A large 3.0-inch LCD wide angel viewing screen, easy-capture features and four fun colors allow the photographer to express their personality with every shot. Suggested price is $129.99
